title: Results of the sixth population census in the Kingdom of the Netherlands, December 31st 1879
descriptions: The dataset is based on the population census of the Netherlands of 1879 published in 12 vols. Content: images of the publication, searchable pdf files of the text sections and excel files with data entered from the published tables.
